title: Office Supplies & Questionable Hires
intro: First buy a proper PI office. Then fill it with equipment and questionable employees.

items.name: New PI Office
items.description: A proper office with room for equipment and employees. Your current office requires visitors to exhale before entering.
items.benefitText: Unlock purchases of office equipment and staff. Equipment is sold separately. Pigeon feed does not require a new office.
items.purchaseMessage: New PI office purchased. Equipment and staff purchases are now unlocked.

items.name: Office Assistant
items.description: Handles appointments, negotiates fees and explains that exposure is not a currency.
items.benefitText: Earn 15% extra on eligible PI contract fees paid after hiring. Bribes, refunds, advances and employee income are excluded.
items.purchaseMessage: Assistant hired. Your calendar is organised. Your life remains under review.

items.name: Case Filing System
items.description: A filing system for solved cases. Alphabetical order costs extra. We have declined.
items.benefitText: Search completed PI cases, contacts, summaries and objectives.
items.purchaseMessage: Files installed. The paperwork now has somewhere to hide.

items.name: Office Printer
items.description: Prints reports, invoices and occasional cries for help. Paper jams are its preferred form of communication.
items.benefitText: Unlock document jobs: up to 2 new jobs per game day, $35 per job, 30 in-game minutes to start.
items.purchaseMessage: Printer installed. It already claims to be out of cyan.

items.name: Junior Investigator
items.description: Takes small local jobs while you handle the dramatic ones. Has only followed the wrong person twice. This week.
items.benefitText: Generate $25 net income per full 24 in-game hours. Collect up to $100 in this office shop.
items.purchaseMessage: Investigator hired. Someone else can now watch the wrong doorway.
